notes: Hashes are md5 over the RAW pixel buffer (Image.GetData()), never over the saved PNG.
A GPU or driver change legitimately moves every hash at once; the gpu field above is what these were captured on. Regenerate after a driver update, and say so in the commit message.
A landed visual change updates this file in the SAME commit and names the shots it moved. An unexplained flip is a stop-the-line finding, not a regeneration.

exercises = what the shot covers TODAY, one sentence under 250 chars. REWRITE it on a re-pin, never append: no past-change deltas, no item ids, no dates. A commit hook enforces this. History is git log -p on this file; reasoning is the commit message.
The runner appends --screenshot=<abs path> and --log-file=<abs path>; everything else is the args below verbatim.

shots.name: c1-waterfall
shots.exercises: UV scroll on the falls sheet, the mist puffer carried on the mission wind and drawn farthest-first, the alpha-textured spray under the zone's world light, and the ridge's conifer cards blended rather than cut; frame-sensitive 1.28 % at 120 vs 121.
